ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Election Fraud in Arizona
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's investigation into election fraud in Arizona and explore the potential connections to other states.
questions: What are the allegations of election fraud in Arizona?
How does the FBI's investigation impact the integrity of the electoral process?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the importance of election integrity. By following the money and exploring the connections between entities, we can get to the bottom of this story and provide a comprehensive report.
